info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Recordings Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve recordings of meetings. It provides essential capabilities for stakeholders to review past discussions and decisions, serving as a valuable resource for enhancing collaboration and accountability. Typical consumers of this API include team leaders, project managers, and any personnel interested in revisiting meeting content for reference or compliance purposes. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline information sharing and ensure critical insights are preserved.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch recordings of meetings for review or archival purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve recording information for meetings. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the meeting whose recordings you want to access.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsRequest.description: A request body for retrieving meeting recordings in JSON format.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsResponse_2.title: Meeting Recording Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result of the recording operation.

state.description: The current state of the recording operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information regarding the recording operation.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsResponse_2.description: The response schema for the GET operation on meeting recordings.
